::: {#def-sem name="Semantics"}
For a formula $\varphi$ and a valuation $v$, $\llbracket\varphi\rrbracket_v$ is its value, and $\left[\varphi\right]_v$ its class:

$$
\llbracket t\rrbracket_{\rho} = \left(\frac{a+b}{c}\right)_v
$$
:::

::: {#thm-sem}
If $x^2 + y^2 = z^2$ then $\llbracket x \rrbracket_v \le z$.
:::
